incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 502/504 rate for customer CustEdge (private VPC) behind NLB -> ALB chain. Observed spike at 2026-03-17T14:12Z, error burst across three AZs. root cause unknown. Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, joining bridge now. Who's owning network changes?

sanjay (eng-net): I'm available. Quick ask: is this hitting the NLB directly or origin ALB targets timing out? Metrics show TCP resets on NLB frontends.

elaine (platform): Correlating logs now. Kibana query: `status:502 AND client:vpc-CustEdge` shows increased 502 from target-group tg-custedge-backend. Healthchecks are flapping for several targets.

maria (oncall): Custops contacted: custops-john, are you seeing any config churn on your side? Any recent SG or route updates?

custops-john: No config changes from CustEdge in the last 24h. Customer reports intermittent responses and timeouts. They see 502 page in-app. They've paused deploys.

ryan (SRE): I'm pulling tcpdump from NLB nodes to check for TLS handshake failures. Attaching sample: `tcpdump -n -s 0 -w /tmp/nb.pcap port 443 and host 10.4.2.18` — seeing repeated `RST, ACK` from target IPs.

nate (secops): Quick security check: no recent SG rule additions in audit log for this VPC. However AWS WAF logs show increased rule hits on ALB which could be causing backend drops. I'll keep monitoring.

sanjay (eng-net): Hypothesis: backend instances (or envoy) are evicting connections under memory pressure leading to 502s at ALB. Can we temporarily route traffic to fallback target group in the nearest AZ?

elaine (platform): We have a warm fallback TG (tg-custedge-fallback). Proposal: shift 30% traffic to fallback TG via weighted ALB target-group routing and reduce healthcheck aggressiveness for primary for stabilization.

maria (oncall): Sounds good. Can you run the change? I'll notify customer and PS.

sanjay (eng-net): Executing plan now: `aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --default-actions '[{"Type":"forward","ForwardConfig":{"TargetGroups":[{"TargetGroupArn":"arn:tg-primary","Weight":70},{"TargetGroupArn":"arn:tg-fallback","Weight":30}]}}]'` — applying.

incident-bot: Deploy bot user: listener modification submitted by sanjay. CI job id 4021. Waiting for AWS confirmation.

elaine (platform): Also changing healthcheck interval on primary TG: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:tg-primary --attributes Key=healthcheck.interval_seconds,Value=30` to reduce flapping.

maria (oncall): Noted. CustEdge notified: "We are routing part of your traffic to a fallback pool and adjusting healthchecks to stabilize. Expect degraded latency while we triage."

custops-john: Thanks. Customer is enabling verbose logs on their side and will share backend error messages.

ryan (SRE): After weight shift, 502 rate dropped ~40% in 2m. NLB TCP resets still present but less correlated to client errors now. Forwarding pcap to eng-net.

sanjay (eng-net): Received pcap. Seeing `connection reset by peer` from pod IPs — backend envoy logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection` at roughly same time as increase in request concurrency. Suggest increasing connection pool size and bump envoy worker threads for this fleet.

nate (secops): Double-checked SGs: we can loosen ephemeral port egress from targets temporarily to allow longer connection windows from ALB. I'll propose a temporary rule: allow ephemeral ports 32768-65535 outbound to NLB IPs for tg-backend instances.

maria (oncall): Approve temporary SG change for 30 minutes if secops approves rollback plan. Need to document change and owner.

nate (secops): Applying temporary SG update now: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abcd --protocol tcp --port 32768-65535 --cidr 10.4.0.0/16` — will set timer for automatic revoke in 30m.

incident-bot: Security group modification recorded by audit. Action ID sg-change-62987.

elaine (platform): After SG tweak + weight shift, error rate returned near baseline in 6m. Healthchecks stabilized. We'll keep fallback traffic at 20% for 15m and then step down if stable.

maria (oncall): Great. Handing off to sanjay for continued remediation and to coordinate a permanent config (envoy pool sizing + probe tuning). I'll remain on-call for customer comms. Escalate if regressions.

sanjay (eng-net): Taking ownership for postmortem and permanent mitigation. I'll schedule change window to update envoy config and target-group healthcheck settings. Also will prepare rollback steps.

custops-john: Customer confirms services restored and no data loss observed. They requested a timeline for permanent fix.

maria (oncall): ETA for permanent fix (envoy tuning + controlled deploy) 24-48 hours. We'll open a follow-up with custops and include runbook steps.

ryan (SRE): Adding short-runbook here for next oncall: 1) Check ALB target-group health, 2) query envoy logs for `upstream prematurely closed connection`, 3) if spike, shift weights to fallback 20-30%, 4) allow ephemeral egress temporarily, 5) notify custops.

nate (secops): Revoke SG temporary rule in 30m or on confirmation of stability.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active paging. Summary: transient backend connection exhaustion in CustEdge private VPC causing NLB resets and ALB 502s. Mitigation: weighted routing to fallback TG, temporary SG egress allowance, healthcheck tuning. Owner: sanjay (eng-net) for follow-up, maria (oncall) for customer comms. :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): Thanks team. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and schedule a customer update call.

sanjay (eng-net): Noted. I'll start a PR for envoy config and coordinate deploy window.

custops-john: Appreciated, team. Customer will expect the postmortem and timeline."
